note: JSON:API Image Styles adds a computed base field 'image_style_uri' to File entities and an admin form at /admin/config/services/jsonapi/image_styles that stores an allow-list in jsonapi_image_styles.settings key 'image_styles'. Empty/all-unchecked allow-list exposes ALL image styles; a non-empty selection exposes only those. Selected = value equals the style id (truthy); unselected = '0'. All medium/hard cases are grounded in that config: introspection reads which styles the live config exposes; execution sets the allow-list and verify checks array_filter(image_styles) keys exactly. No permission of its own (settings form gated by core 'Administer image styles'); no Drush; no config schema; no public plugin types.

evals.prompt: In a decoupled Drupal setup I enabled the JSON:API Image Styles module. Which computed field does it add, to which entity type, and where do the image-style derivative URLs show up in a JSON:API response?
evals.expected_output: It adds a computed base field 'image_style_uri' to the File entity type. JSON:API serializes it into each file--file resource's attributes as a map of image_style_machine_name => absolute derivative URL (built with ImageStyle::buildUrl). Include the file (e.g. ?include=field_image) and read image_style_uri off the file resource.

evals.prompt: Using the JSON:API Image Styles module, how do I limit which image styles are exposed to JSON:API, which config object/key stores that, and what happens if I select none?
evals.expected_output: Go to /admin/config/services/jsonapi/image_styles (Configuration > Web Services > JSON:API Image Styles) and check the styles to expose. The selection is stored in jsonapi_image_styles.settings under the 'image_styles' key. If none are selected (empty allow-list), ALL defined image styles are exposed - that is the default behaviour.

evals.prompt: For the JSON:API Image Styles module, what is the settings page path and which permission controls access to it? Does the module define its own permission?
evals.expected_output: The settings form is at /admin/config/services/jsonapi/image_styles (route jsonapi_image_styles.settings). It is gated by the core 'Administer image styles' permission; the module defines no permission of its own.

evals.prompt: This site restricts which image styles JSON:API Image Styles exposes. Inspect the live configuration and name the image styles that are currently exposed to JSON:API.
evals.expected_output: Two styles are exposed: thumbnail and large. jsonapi_image_styles.settings.image_styles selects thumbnail and large (value == id), while medium and wide are '0' (not exposed).

evals.prompt: On this site, is the 'medium' image style exposed to JSON:API through JSON:API Image Styles? Inspect the live configuration and explain which styles are exposed.
evals.expected_output: No, 'medium' is not exposed. jsonapi_image_styles.settings.image_styles has only 'wide' selected (truthy); thumbnail, large and medium are '0', so only the 'wide' style is exposed.

evals.prompt: Configure the JSON:API Image Styles module on this site so that ONLY the 'thumbnail' image style is exposed to JSON:API (no other styles). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set jsonapi_image_styles.settings.image_styles so that only 'thumbnail' is truthy (e.g. ['thumbnail' => 'thumbnail']) and save. array_filter() of the value must be exactly ['thumbnail'].

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure JSON:API Image Styles to expose exactly the 'thumbnail' and 'large' image styles to JSON:API and no others. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set jsonapi_image_styles.settings.image_styles so that thumbnail and large are truthy and every other style is falsy/absent, then save. array_filter() keys must equal {large, thumbnail}.
